title: Book vocabulary and chapter-bank reconciliation proposals

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Refresh inventory and aliases, pinned never-merge pairs, flagged pair keys and watermark; stale inventory blocks on-create clearance.
Use matching.py and existing delta/full/on_create scripts. Delta is normal changed-input review; full sweep is explicit wider review.
Keep node kinds distinct; exclude archives, deliberate Final supersession and Draft parallel trees from destructive dedup proposals.
Title-match clear is not semantic uniqueness; review distinctive terms and canonical homes before any later approved mint.
No graph mutation occurs in this review contract. Preserve legacy apply tiers as source history; do not infer current write approval.

success_checks: Review identifies each pair, layer, evidence and keep-separate or alias/merge recommendation without applying it.
Already adjudicated pairs and pinned distinctions stay preserved; existing bank or Published-as candidates are not duplicated.
Any later state stamp must describe an actual verified run, never merely a page edit timestamp.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
